goal: Pursue 100,000 portfolio citation/impression opportunities in six months while preserving truthful evidence, contextual usefulness, and measured backlink quality.
default_launch_date: auto-created on first run if data/autopilot-state.json is missing

daily_rules.condition: last_7_day_pass_rate >= 0.85 and duplicate warnings are diagnostic only, else 3
hold at 6 unless pass rate drops below 0.75, then 3
9 only if last_14_day_pass_rate >= 0.85, avg_quality >= 85, duplicate warnings are diagnostic only
9 if quality remains healthy; 6 if mixed; 3 if failures rise

hard_limits._why_max_brand_page_share_per_publicatio: No single affiliated brand may be cited from more than a third of any publication's pages. Measured 2026-08-28, the leading brand in the two publications with no concentration problem sits at 31.4% (virtual-agency-os of founder-operator's 105 pages) and 32.7% (porch-party of memphis-local's 104); professional-resources had approval-prep on 69.0% of 420. The cap is the third the two healthy publications bracket, so it is the network's own observed norm rather than a round number. Enforced before generation in scripts/authority_v4_autopilot.py and over published output by scripts/validators/validate_brand_link_concentration.py. Every one of these citations already carries rel="sponsored nofollow" and passes no ranking signal, so nothing is lost to search by removing one; what the cap protects is the claim each page makes about being a resource library rather than a channel for one product.

priority_targets.quality_policy: Only contextually relevant Community as a Service pages.
Only real wedding planning problems and matching product destinations.
Recovery housing education only; preserve clinical and licensure boundaries.
Workplace and service education without diagnosis or outcome claims.
Equine legal education only; no legal advice.

_priority_targets_note: approval-prep was removed from this list on 2026-08-28. It was the only entry with pages_per_day: 6 and no until_rendered_coverage, so unlike every other priority target it had no stop condition, and it took the front of the daily job list every day until it held 290 of professional-resources' 420 pages against a declared minimum_rendered_coverage of 2. It is not in deficit and does not need a priority lane; it competes through choose_fair_target() with every other target, which weights by deficit and will now rarely pick it. Its pages, campaign and destinations are unchanged.
